tickets.problem: Asset stickers such as 00417 register as 0417 at the stores counter only when scanned. Typing the full number works at that counter.
tickets.resolution: Turned off the handheld reader's option to skip the first character. It transmitted 00417 in full on a test scan.

tickets.problem: Scanning a stock tag into the asset entry form drops its leading zeroes. The reader sends the full string to a text editor, but 00417 is stored as 417 on the form.
tickets.resolution: Changed the tag field on the asset entry form from a number to text. The next scan preserved both leading zeroes.

tickets.problem: Mileage entered in kilometres is being reimbursed as miles in a member of staff's draft travel claims. Their profile was copied from a different office.
tickets.resolution: Set the distance unit in the employee's travel profile to kilometres and recalculated the affected draft claims.

tickets.problem: The induction slide show plays its music, but the recorded voice-over cannot be heard. The narration is present in the slide editor.
tickets.resolution: Enabled Play Narrations in the slide show settings. The recorded voice was audible on the next run.

tickets.problem: A visitor can sign on the reception tablet, but the signature vanishes after tapping Accept. A replacement pen has been suggested and has not been tested.
On the reception signing pad each stroke is reflected left to right, including the saved image. The visitor's signature is saved successfully.
tickets.resolution: Turned off the pad driver's Mirror horizontal axis option. A new signature had the correct orientation.

tickets.problem: Finance imported a European budget file. A line for 12,50 showed up as 1250, and the original file was still available.
tickets.resolution: Selected comma as the decimal separator in the budget importer, then repeated the import from the original file.

tickets.problem: At the library returns desk, books scanned at the start of the morning appear against yesterday's lending session. The barcode on each book is read correctly.
tickets.resolution: Closed the previous lending session and opened a new session for the current shift on the returns terminal.

tickets.problem: The belt on the library book sorter halts after the seventh return. Someone suspects the inlet sensor. The sorter has not been inspected yet.
The map team's PDF of a wall map cuts off the right side of the legend. The legend extends beyond the layout frame on this map.
tickets.resolution: Widened the layout frame to enclose the entire legend before exporting the wall map again.

tickets.problem: On another wall map the right edge of the legend is missing in the exported PDF, although the whole legend fits the layout frame. The project uses A3 pages.
tickets.resolution: Set the PDF export paper size to A3 to match the project layout. The legend then fit on the page.

tickets.problem: Pictures taken on the inspectors' new phones have a .heic extension. They open on the phones, but the Windows inspection workstation cannot preview them.
tickets.resolution: Installed HEIF Image Extensions on the inspection workstation. The existing photos then opened in the Windows viewer.

tickets.problem: English speech from the minute taker is transcribed as French words. Changing the keyboard language did not change the dictation output.
tickets.resolution: Set the speech recognition language in the dictation profile to English (United Kingdom). The next passage was transcribed in English.

tickets.problem: The USB foot pedal used to control interview dictation stopped accepting presses twice in a session.
tickets.resolution: Disconnecting and reconnecting the pedal restored input for the session. Diagnostics did not establish a hardware fault or a cause.

tickets.problem: The secretary receives a signature request for the committee minutes before the chair signs. Both signers should approve in sequence.
tickets.resolution: Changed the minutes template to sequential signing, with the chair first and the secretary second.

tickets.problem: The pool car portal always opens with the closed North depot selected. The driver needs Central as the starting pickup location for future bookings.
tickets.resolution: Saved Central as the default pickup depot in the driver's booking profile.

tickets.problem: Drivers see a pool car reservation in the mobile wallet without its pickup QR code. Support is still checking the wallet pass.
The print room's timetable booklet has all the correct stops, but the pages listing them come out in reverse order. The PDF reads correctly.
tickets.resolution: Disabled reverse page order in the timetable booklet print preset. The next booklet followed the PDF order.

tickets.problem: The outdoor bus stop displays the old timetable in dry weather, while the new timetable is already published. The screen remains readable.
tickets.resolution: Updated the display's schedule feed to point to the current timetable. The next refresh showed the new times.

tickets.problem: The rehearsal calendar sends band members two reminders for the same practice. Both the retired practice feed and the current Ensemble feed are subscribed.
tickets.resolution: Removed the retired practice feed and kept the Ensemble subscription. One reminder arrived for the next rehearsal.

tickets.problem: Players receive two rehearsal reminders even with only one calendar feed subscribed. An old email rule for rehearsal notices is still enabled alongside the calendar alert.
tickets.resolution: Disabled the old email reminder rule and kept the calendar alert. Players received one notice for the next practice.

tickets.problem: The subtitles on a training video consistently appear before the speaker says the words. The same offset lasts through the entire video.
tickets.resolution: Delayed the subtitle track by 2.5 seconds and saved the corrected track. Its cues then matched the speech.

tickets.problem: After exhibits were rearranged, stop 14 on the museum audio guide plays the old exhibit's narration instead of the otter recording.
tickets.resolution: Assigned the otter recording to stop 14 in the guide editor and published the revised guide.

tickets.problem: Headphones on the portable museum audio guide crackle on outdoor tours. Staff have not tested their suggestion to replace the headphone lead.
The archive's film scanner turns colour slides into greyscale files, although the originals contain colour.
tickets.resolution: Selected the 24-bit colour scanning preset. New scans retained the original colours.

tickets.problem: The loan counter gets an empty second submission after scanning an equipment tag and pressing Enter. The reader already sends Enter after the tag.
tickets.resolution: Disabled the automatic Enter suffix on the loan counter reader. The clerk's own Enter key then submitted the form once.

tickets.problem: Reviewers found yesterday's annotations missing when they reopened a proof in the browser.
tickets.resolution: Recovered the annotations from a locally saved review copy. The cause of their disappearance remained undetermined.

tickets.problem: Staff can find the campus room directory entry by its old wing name but cannot find the renamed wing. Both names need to work.
tickets.resolution: Published the directory entry under the new wing name and kept the former name as a searchable alias.

tickets.problem: Letters sent to the engraving desk appear as rectangles in the design import. The engraver accepts SVG artwork and does not have the designer's font.
tickets.resolution: Converted the lettering to paths and exported the artwork as SVG. The engraving preview then showed the letter shapes.

tickets.problem: Recorded talks sound much faster than live speech when staff review demos in the media player. The playback control shows 1.5x.
tickets.resolution: Returned the media player to normal speed (1x). The recording itself needed no change.

tickets.problem: A second recorded talk plays too fast even at normal playback speed. The file is marked 48 kHz although the recorder captured the audio at 32 kHz.
tickets.resolution: Set the audio editor to interpret the recording at its original 32 kHz, then exported a corrected copy. Speech played at the intended speed.

tickets.problem: The public class catalogue shows Staff instead of the assigned instructor's name. The class record contains the correct name but the publication option is off.
tickets.resolution: Enabled Publish tutor name on the class record. The public listing then displayed the assigned instructor.

tickets.problem: After replacing the mat on the paper cutter, each design is cut 8 mm to one side. The blade follows the shape correctly.
tickets.resolution: Reset the cutter's origin to the registration cross on the replacement mat.

tickets.problem: The mat cutter stops midway when cutting a circle, even though straight cuts finish. A firmware update is being considered and no version has been tested.
Photos taken at the packing bench end up on the next parcel's record when the operator opens that parcel. The picture itself is clear.
tickets.resolution: Changed the camera station to attach the image when the shutter is pressed. A test photo stayed with the current parcel.

tickets.problem: A tutor types a fraction such as 3/4 into a blank workbook cell and sees a date. The entries need to remain numbers for calculations.
tickets.resolution: Applied the Fraction number format to the cells before entering the values. The fractions could then be used in sums.

tickets.problem: When the training room copies two-sided originals for handouts, every other source page is missing from the copies.
tickets.resolution: Selected two-sided originals on the copier's input settings and copied the handouts again. Both sides were captured.

tickets.problem: The print room's copier counter increases overnight when the room is empty. A service visit has been requested.
On a library e-reader, opening a borrowed title immediately returns the reader to the shelf. The e-reader's clock shows an old date and the loan is treated as expired.
tickets.resolution: Enabled automatic date and time on the e-reader and synced its clock. The existing loan then opened.

tickets.problem: A borrowed title on another library e-reader flashes open and goes back to the shelf. The clock is correct. The loan was downloaded to the removable card.
tickets.resolution: Moved the downloaded loan from the SD card to the e-reader's internal storage. The book opened from the shelf.

tickets.problem: The seating plan editor moves two chairs together after importing an SVG drawing. They should be positioned independently.
tickets.resolution: Used Ungroup on the imported chairs in the seating plan editor. Each chair could then be dragged separately.

tickets.problem: The ticket counter lost power during a split payment. The sale is still under investigation and there is no recovery note.
Captions generated for new lectures run words together without commas or full stops. Earlier lecture recordings have proper punctuation.
tickets.resolution: Enabled automatic punctuation in the transcription profile, then regenerated the captions for the affected lectures.

tickets.problem: A reservation slip at the library loan desk sometimes names another patron with the same surname. Staff had selected the first matching surname.
tickets.resolution: Changed the desk procedure to select the borrower by their unique borrower number. The next slip showed the intended patron.

tickets.problem: The volunteer roster copied from last term opens with Sunday at the left. The team wants its shared weekly view to begin on Monday.
tickets.resolution: Changed the roster's week start to Monday and saved that view as the team default.

tickets.problem: New children's items at the library kiosk have been charging the adult late fee. Some fines have already been posted.
tickets.resolution: Changed the affected items' loan category to Junior and recalculated their outstanding fines.

tickets.problem: The campus bell sounds one minute late every afternoon. Staff suspect the controller, but nobody has diagnosed the cause.
The engraver cuts the outlines of letters twice, although the preview shows the correct letter shapes.
tickets.resolution: Removed overlapping duplicate paths from the drawing. The engraver then made one pass per outline.

tickets.problem: A timetable prints with a strip cut off its right edge, but the individual pages are in the correct order.
tickets.resolution: Reduced the print scale to fit the timetable within the printable area.

tickets.problem: A cashier at the ticket counter sees two receipts after a split payment that completed normally. There was no power interruption.
tickets.resolution: Disabled the extra merchant-copy receipt in the point-of-sale print settings.

tickets.problem: The borrower number on a library reservation slip is too small to read, but the intended patron is selected.
tickets.resolution: Increased the borrower number font size in the reservation slip template.

tickets.problem: The captions on a training video are in sync but disappear against a light background.
tickets.resolution: Added an opaque background behind the caption text.

tickets.problem: In the campus directory, searching the current wing name finds the room, but its floor plan shows the entrance on the wrong side.
tickets.resolution: Replaced the mirrored floor plan image in the room directory.
